note: VLA datasets recorded with `hfteama vla <task> record|status|discard|save` (both pairs of the 'bimanual' section of teleop_pairs.json as one robot: 12 joints, cameras left_wrist, right_wrist and the top-level ones below). Each task has ONE dataset with a fixed name: the first session creates it, later sessions (night, day) append to it. Datasets live in $HF_LEROBOT_HOME (default ~/.cache/huggingface/lerobot) and reach the Hub only with `save`. Keep the task text, the cameras and their size fixed once a dataset has episodes.

front.controls_note: Set with v4l2-ctl before recording. The sorter leaves the camera in manual exposure and white balance; the VLA records day and night, so give them back to the camera. Focus stays manual (autofocus hunting changes the image).

box_right.task: Move the box to the right
box_right.note: rakesh arm alone grabs one side of the box, lifts it and moves it to the right; hacklab stays still.

box_left.task: Move the box to the left
box_left.note: hacklab arm alone grabs one side of the box, lifts it and moves it to the left; rakesh stays still.

box_middle.task: Lift the box with both arms and place it in the middle
box_middle.note: both arms grab the two ends of the box, lift it together and put it down between the arms.
